issues.legal_issue: An order requiring a tenant to deposit unpaid rent may be made at an interlocutory stage without a full trial of the tenant’s defence.
material_facts: The proceeding sought recovery of possession on the ground of non-payment of rent.
The tenant had not paid rent after the stated period and claimed that rent was to be adjusted against professional fees under an alleged agreement.
The Controller heard the tenant and considered his statement and the material then available, found the alleged adjustment unsupported, and directed deposit of rent.
The tenant could lead evidence about the alleged agreement later, and the deposit was to remain with the Controller pending determination of entitlement.
issues.conclusion: The Controller could direct deposit of the arrears at the preliminary stage; a full trial of the alleged agreement was not a prerequisite.
issues.legal_principle: Section 15(1) of the Delhi Rent Control Act, 1958 requires an opportunity to be heard and provides for deposit of arrears and continuing rent; its provision for monthly deposits, together with sections 15(3), 15(6) and 15(7), shows that the deposit direction is preliminary rather than a final determination. A full trial is not required before such an interim direction. Nalinakhya Bysack v. Shyam Sunder Halder was distinguished because the claimed repair expenditure there formed part of the tenancy terms, whereas the alleged professional-fee adjustment here was a separate arrangement and was found unsupported at that stage.

rule.if: rent_recovery_for_nonpayment and rent_unpaid and hearing_opportunity_given and setoff_claim_unsubstantiated_on_preliminary_record

predicates.rent_recovery_for_nonpayment: A proceeding was brought to recover possession on the ground that rent had not been paid.
predicates.rent_unpaid: The tenant had not paid the rent claimed to be outstanding.
predicates.hearing_opportunity_given: The decision-maker gave the tenant an opportunity to be heard before making the deposit direction.
predicates.setoff_claim_unsubstantiated_on_prelimin: The tenant claimed that rent was set off against another debt, but the material considered at the preliminary stage did not substantiate that claim.
predicates.interlocutory_rent_deposit_order_permiss: A direction to deposit rent may be made before a full trial of the tenant’s defence.

issues.definition: When a non-payment rent-recovery proceeding concerns unpaid rent, the tenant has been heard, and a claimed setoff is not substantiated on the preliminary record, a deposit direction may be made before the defence is fully tried.

issues.legal_issue: A notice requiring a tenant to pay rent to the tax authority does not prevent deposit of that rent with the Controller when the deposited funds will not be released until the authority’s clearance is obtained.
material_facts: A tax officer had served the tenant with a notice directing payment of rent to the tax authority.
In the rent proceeding, the Controller stated that deposited rent would not be paid to anyone until a clearance certificate was obtained from the tax department.
The tenant had not paid the rent to the tax authority and had declined to deposit it with the Controller.
issues.conclusion: The notice did not prevent the tenant from depositing the rent with the Controller, and the deposit in the circumstances would not expose the tenant to personal liability.
issues.legal_principle: Section 46(5A) of the Indian Income-tax Act, 1922 did not make the notice equivalent to a garnishee order that barred payment into court. The provision also allowed a recipient who disputed that money was due to, or held for, the taxpayer to object. Because the Controller would retain the deposit until tax-department clearance, the tenant could deposit it without the asserted risk of personal liability.

predicates.rent_recovery_proceeding: A proceeding was brought to recover rent or possession from a tenant.
predicates.tax_collection_notice_requires_rent_paym: A tax authority notified the tenant to pay rent to it on account of the landlord’s tax debt.
predicates.controller_withholds_deposit_pending_tax: The decision-maker stated that rent deposited with it would not be released until the tax authority provided clearance.
predicates.tenant_may_deposit_rent_without_personal: The tenant may deposit the rent with the decision-maker without incurring the asserted personal liability.

issues.definition: When a tenant in a rent-recovery proceeding has received a tax-collection notice and the decision-maker will retain deposited rent pending tax clearance, the tenant may deposit the rent without the asserted personal liability.
